**What changes for a student** (or "nothing a student sees"):

**Done when** (the reviewer checks each):
- [ ] Refines what's there: simpler or more reliable, no new layer, setting or library nobody asked for
- [ ] Uses the toolkit (CLAUDE.md), and `tools/check-connections.sh` counts didn't go up
- [ ] One focused test where something could really break, with no fixed waits
- [ ] Pictures from the off-screen drawing if any screen changed
- [ ] Plain words for a student; nothing private (public repo)
